title: Families mourn those killed as Israeli strikes pound the Gaza Strip overnight
description:
(2 Aug 2026) 
RESTRICTION SUMMARY:

ASSOCIATED PRESS
Khan Younis, southern Gaza Strip – 2 August 2026 
1. Various of women crying beside wrapped bodies of relatives
2. Various of relatives mourning around wrapped bodies
3. Mourners carrying wrapped body
4. Various of wrapped bodies on ground, surrounded by mourners
5. Various of mourners offering funeral prayers
6. Various of mourners carrying wrapped bodies from Nasser Hospital

ASSOCIATED PRESS
Deir al-Balah, Central Gaza Strip – 2 August 2026 
7. Various of people carrying wrapped bodies and placing them on ground 
8. Various of mourners offering funeral prayers
9. Various of mourners carrying wrapped bodies and placing them in ambulance 
STORYLINE:
Israeli strikes on Sunday across Gaza killed at least eight Palestinians, including two children, and wounded over a dozen others, according to local health officials.

A strike on a residential apartment in southern Gaza killed three family members, including their four-year-old child, according to Nasser hospital, where the bodies arrived.

Another strike, also on a residential apartment, in Gaza City killed three family members, including a child, and wounded others, according to health officials at the Shifa hospital. 

In central Gaza, a man and his wife were killed in an Israeli strike, which wounded four other people in the area, according to the main hospital serving central Gaza.

The Israeli military said the overnight strikes had targeted Hamas military operatives, without elaborating.

At least 1,222 Palestinians, including at least 260 children, have been killed since an October ceasefire was agreed between Israel and Hamas, according to Gaza’s Health Ministry.

Five Israeli soldiers have been killed in that time.

Both Hamas and Israel continue to trade accusations of violating the ceasefire.

Hamas said Friday that it will begin disarming as part of a deal announced by U.S. President Donald Trump that also requires Israel to end its strikes and withdraw from Gaza. 

It marked a potential breakthrough in ending the war, but implementation faces major challenges.
